posts.name: blake.senn
posts.cooked:
drstein:

The Forced Deployment event that brings all minions back into play were controlled by Omni-X destroying the ongoing

Destroying Forced Deployment doesn't help you  at all. Its "all the minions you killed come back into play" effect happens on destruction, not at the start of the villain turn. Further, Voss's alternate victory condition is checked first thing at the start of his turn (since it's on the card which has been on the table before any other card was placed, the setup card), so letting Forced Deployment go off on its own gives you a full round to take out all the minions, while destroying it with Omni, at the absolute best, means you have one less card play to kill off the minions. At its worst, if Omni is the last hero to act in the round, it gives you one power and the environment turn to prevent a loss.
